summary.en: A centred hero title shrinks in one move into the section label at the top left while the section's content grows in under it; optionally a text selection sweeps over it first.
summary.zh: 居中的大标题一口气缩小、飞到左上角落成小节标签，下面的内容在它落地的同时长出来；可选先扫过一道文本选区。

fits: Opening a chapter: the title is the subject for a beat, then becomes the signpost of the content that grows under it; with select, a menu item becoming the heading of what it opens.
notFor: A title that should stay the figure; sections without content to grow (it then reads as a title shrinking for nothing); titles over about three words; styles that never rescale type.

intent.en: The title steps down instead of leaving, so the viewer keeps a free spatial memory: the big word from a moment ago is the small label up there, and this section is about it.
intent.zh: 标题降格而不退场，观众白得一份空间记忆：刚才的大字就是左上角那个小标签，这一节讲的就是它。

content.en: A section title of up to three words (≤ 20 chars), an optional number ("01") and eyebrow, and the section content to grow under it (blocks in reading order).
content.zh: 一个不超过三个词的小节标题（≤ 6 字），可选编号（“01”）和眉题，以及要在下面长出来的本节内容（按阅读顺序的块）。

fits.zh: 章节开场：标题先当一拍主角，再变成下面长出的内容的门牌；select 式让菜单项变成它打开那一页的标题。

notFor.zh: 应该一直当主角的标题；下面没有内容可长的小节（就成了标题无故缩小）；超过约三个词的标题；从不缩放文字的风格。

pairs.note: the title enters first, holds a beat, then steps down

en: Nothing else may move on the title's path; a popup or pointer entering on the same frame steals the eye.
Used in several sections, the new label replaces the old one; stacked labels make the corner a graveyard.
The select highlight says "this text can be selected": use it only for editing or document products.
zh: 标题飞行路径上不许有别的东西动；同帧入场的弹窗或光标会抢走视线。
多节连用时新标签替换旧标签，叠放会让左上角变成标签坟场。
select 的选中高亮暗示“文字可被选中”，只给编辑器或文档类产品用。

upstream.name: 标题降格标签
upstream.summary: 大标题降格为节标签两式——A 大标题居中显影站稳一拍后连续缩小 0.3x 平移到左上角落成小节标签、内容区在其下生长；B 同套路但登场时带文本选中态高亮块扫入再撤掉
upstream.use: 章节开场（标题先当主角再让位给内容）；教程/功能演示片的小节交接；B 式给"文字/编辑"类产品加身份暗示
upstream.energy: 低中（版式变换型，氛围镜头）

overlaps.note: card-portal opens a part into the whole; title-demote turns the whole title into the label of its part
